entities.name: Robert P. Reed
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Philip Reed is an American Catholic prelate who has served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Boston in Massachusetts since 2016. He is the president of the CatholicTV Network.
